title: A deployment in another organisation needs nothing from ours
description:
Folds in PPY-1a6aa6's bootstrap complaint: bootstrap.sh defaulted to this repository and wrote its AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable.

```gherkin
Feature: A second organisation bootstraps without touching ours

  Scenario: Bootstrapping touches only the new deployment
    Given an account in another AWS organisation and its own repository
    When the account is seeded
    Then the roles trust only that repository
    And no variable, domain or account of the Anthus deployments is read or written
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Delivered 2026-11-11 (Papyrus PRs 1404, 1405, 1407, 1408, 1409). First real use: Humorus account pipeline run https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus/actions/runs/43117405856: roles applied with no approval, zone and budget imported (name servers and budget unchanged), SES created. docs/account-pipeline.md has the person-only list. Anthus imports (PPY-b5ddec) and the client-owned account (PPY-1f6e73) are still open design and dry-run work.
